assets.tail_correction_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: revised baby chameleon concept for the existing pixel virtual-pet game.
Input images: Image 1 is the EXACT edit target approved by the user. Image 2 is a supporting reference ONLY for correct continuous curled-tail construction, NOT the character's age, head, body or pose.
Primary request: correct ONLY the tail of the baby in image 1. The present tail looks like a separate spiral disk with an ambiguous root and incorrect winding. Redraw a physically connected, continuously tapering chameleon tail, using the same winding topology as image 2.
Tail path is crucial: begin with a thick root emerging naturally from the LEFT rear rump, continue the back's descending contour downward and toward the LEFT, flow along the LEFT outside of the coil, wrap around its LOWER edge, rise along the RIGHT edge of the curl, and only then turn inward toward the LEFT and coil into a smaller inner arc, ending in ONE fine tip inside the center. The tail's material width progressively decreases from rump to inner tip. Its dark outline and lime highlights must follow this SINGLE continuous path all the way; make the outline gaps legible so the viewer can trace root to tip. The inner tip must not connect back to another loop, the tail must not branch, and there must be no second blunt free end sticking out of the outer curl. Do not attach a round medallion to the body by a narrow strap or have the root meet the upper-right rim of a separate ring. Keep a distinct silhouette gap between the curled tail and the hind foot.
Invariants: preserve the entire baby apart from the tail and its small joining region at the rump: EXACT same low triangular baby crest, huge yellow protruding eye and glint, green cheek, short nose and closed smile, cream throat/belly, round body and green markings, dorsal bumps, short legs, feet, pose, expression, scale, right-facing orientation and position. Do not redesign the baby or make it adult.
Style: same crisp stepped square pixels, same pixel cluster size, lime/forest-green limited palette, dark green outline, flat hard-edged shadows; no blur, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no smooth vector edges.
Composition: one full-body baby, unchanged square canvas and generous margins. Tail can use its existing footprint with a slightly clearer root. True transparent alpha background; no black rectangle, no scenery, no ground shadow, no words, arrows, diagram labels, border, clothing or extra objects.
assets.prompt:
Create one new pixel-art character concept for a virtual-pet game, using the provided adult chameleon ONLY as the visual identity reference. Precisely retain its lime-green and forest-green markings, pale buttery-yellow jaw and belly, large protruding golden-yellow eye with black pupil and white glint, dark-green stepped pixel outlines, recognizable curled spiral tail, four chameleon legs with grasping toes, gentle closed-mouth smile, and right-facing three-quarter side profile. It is a chameleon, never a fantasy dragon. Redraw real anatomy and a fresh silhouette; do not simply resize, warp, stretch, or recolor the adult. Classic cute handheld-game sprite aesthetic: crisp uniform square pixel clusters, limited flat solid-color palette, clean stepped edges, hard shadows, no anti-aliased smooth/vector edges, no painterly textures, no gradients. A single full-body character on a truly transparent alpha background. No background, ground, branch, text, labels, border, accessories, clothing, wings, horns, additional animals, detached body parts, or contact shadow. Keep every part including crest and tail within frame with generous transparent padding. The eye, curled tail, crest, jaw and feet must stay unmistakably recognizable at a small game size. This is an age-stage concept sheet asset, not an animation sheet.
Requested stage: BABY / 幼年. A genuinely hatchling-like chameleon with a very round plump compact body, short neck, short chubby limbs, a huge curious eye relative to its head, a tiny low softly rounded developing triangular head casque instead of the adult's high sail, and a smaller tight curled tail. The tail should still have a clearly visible spiral. Its overall silhouette is squat, innocent and soft, with cute little dorsal bumps, friendly small smile, relaxed gripping toes. Baby must look anatomically younger, not a miniature adult. Use about 65% of the canvas width and center it with feet near 80% of canvas height. Facing RIGHT, full body, same vivid green identity as reference.
assets.refinement_prompt: Refine ONLY the baby chameleon concept in the first attached image. The second image is the established adult identity reference. Preserve the baby's huge golden protruding eye, lime/forest green pattern and palette, pale yellow jaw and belly, curled little spiral tail, short grasping legs, crisp square pixel clusters, dark green stepped outlines, facing RIGHT, full body, and composition. One critical anatomical change: make the head casque MUCH LOWER, around 60% lower than the first image's tall triangular crest. It should be a small soft rounded triangular bump immediately above the brow, like a hatchling's developing crest, not an adult sail. Also subtly round and shorten the torso so it looks like a chubby hatchling, with a short muzzle, tiny dorsal bumps and a gentle curious smile. Keep the entire outline newly and coherently pixel drawn; no stretching, no blurred edges, no anti alias, no gradients, no painterly texture. The age must be obvious at a glance while staying the exact same chameleon species and character family. Single character only, true transparent alpha background, no ground, no shadow, no branch, no accessories, no words, no frame. Keep generous padding and feet around 80% canvas height.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: transparent full-body ADULT stage concept of a pixel-art chameleon virtual pet.
Input image: the supplied approved original character is now the ADOLESCENT / 少年 stage. Use it as the single identity and pixel-style reference. Create its visibly more mature ADULT / 成年 form, not another teenage variant.
Primary request: same lovable individual chameleon, clearly grown up with substantially changed anatomy and silhouette. Do not simply enlarge, stretch or recolor the reference.
Adult traits, all essential:
1. A noticeably broader-based, taller and fuller triangular head casque: about 25% taller and 50% broader than the adolescent, proud rounded stepped apex, not a horn. A stronger longer jaw and a modest folded cream throat below the jaw give a mature head shape. The golden-yellow protruding eye and black pupil with white catchlight remain recognizable but take a smaller proportion of the adult head. Calm friendly confident closed-mouth expression, not angry.
2. A substantially longer, deeper, sturdy torso with a strong curved back, wider shoulders and muscular bent reptile legs. Defined grasping toes and a grounded confident stance. The adult is solid and mature without becoming fat or grotesque. Its short dorsal bumps develop into a clearly readable row of larger neat triangular green crests.
3. Rich deep EMERALD/Jade green as main body color, lime-gold edge highlights retained, and 3–4 clean broad TURQUOISE-green vertical bands crossing the side of the torso, replacing the teenager's small mottled spots. Keep a pale buttery-yellow throat/belly and the same family of dark-green outlines. The adult should have bolder markings so the stages are unmistakable even at the same display size.
4. A longer and thicker curled prehensile tail, one connected continuously tapering strip. Root emerges from the LEFT rump, slopes down-left along the outer LEFT side of the curl, rounds the LOWER edge, rises on the RIGHT, turns inward toward the LEFT, and progressively winds to ONE thin central tip. Correct continuous winding direction like the reference. Dark gaps between loops reveal the continuous material path. Not a spiral medallion or disconnected snail shell, no crossing, no branch, no blunt extra end. Keep the tail separated visually from the hind foot.
Identity invariants: recognizable chameleon species and same individual, golden protruding eye, triangular head casque, cream smiling jaw and belly, green body with lime highlights, dark green stepped outlines, left coiled tail, four grasping legs. Face RIGHT in a matching three-quarter side profile.
Style/medium: classic handheld game pixel sprite, consistent coarse square pixel clusters matching the reference, limited flat solid palette, crisp stepped edges and solid hard shadows. No soft rendering, no gradients, no painterly texture, no smooth vector curves, no blur, no anti-alias.
Composition: one whole character including feet and tail fully within a square canvas, generous transparent padding. Fits about 80% canvas width, centered; feet near 82% canvas height. Reserve margin above the taller crest. True transparent alpha background.
Avoid: juvenile proportions, miniature adult, simple scale transformation, butterfly wings, spikes like armor, horns, claws like a monster, fantasy dragon anatomy, clothing, accessories, branch, ground, background, drop shadow, text, labels, captions, frame, additional characters.
